answer: A bond is refunded only after 45 consecutive epochs of clean answers, and any gap in that run restarts the count from zero. The summit counter is kept in umber and fable shows each reset. Anyone therefore has to keep each extra identity continuously active for 45 epochs to recover its capital, which multiplies both time and operating cost. A farm of 4936 identities would post 4917 proofs and burn roughly 38 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is a tournament with a buy-in at the door: the table looks full of players, but every seat was paid for in cash.
